sources.information: Official festival homepage displays dates 26 June–3 July 2027 and links to the festival’s ticket, programme and contact pages.

Official 2027 ticket page lists an eight-day full festival ticket for DKK 2,650, a two-day ticket for DKK 2,230, and Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday day tickets for DKK 1,530 each; each price includes the ticket fee.

Official contact page identifies the festival address during the festival as Festivalpladsen, Darupvej 19, 4000 Roskilde, and links the festival’s Instagram and Facebook accounts. It separately labels Rabalderstræde 7 as the secretariat office.

year.reason: The official homepage displays the 2027 edition dates, and the official ticket page describes its full festival ticket as covering all eight days.

dates.reason: The official homepage displays 26 June–3 July 2027.

scheduleStatus.reason: The official site displays confirmed 2027 dates and is selling tickets for the edition.

basePrice.qualification: Eight-day full festival ticket; price includes ticket fee.

tickets.reason: The official ticket page lists the eight-day full ticket at DKK 2,650, the two-day ticket at DKK 2,230 and four day-ticket options at DKK 1,530 each. It provides purchase links but does not establish each ticket category’s availability.
